title: Unit-econ pipeline dashboards + alerts (freshness/completeness + reconciliation variance) wired to oncall
author: Allison Grant
release_notes:
- Adds internal Grafana dashboard for unit-econ dataset freshness/completeness and reconciliation variance
- Adds Prometheus alert rules with paging thresholds and runbook links
- Wires alerts to #eng-sre / #eng-platform and PagerDuty (Eng SRE Oncall)
body: Title: Unit-econ pipeline dashboards + alerts (freshness/completeness + reconciliation variance) wired to oncall Context: As part of the internal unit economics dashboard launch, we need first-class visibility into dataset health (freshness + completeness) and reconciliation with billing/metering. This PR adds a dedicated Grafana dashboard and alert rules to catch regressions early and route them to the right oncall channels. Scope: (1) Grafana dashboard: "Unit Economics — Data Quality" showing freshness lag, partition completeness, and reconciliation variance time series; (2) Prometheus alert rules: warning + paging thresholds for freshness, completeness, and variance; (3) Notification routing: labels and Alertmanager routes to #eng-sre, #eng-platform, and PagerDuty Eng SRE oncall; (4) Runbook links embedded in alerts and dashboard panels. Dashboard panels included: Freshness (by dataset): unit_econ_daily_blended_cost partition_lag_seconds p50/p95; semantic_layer_unit_econ_views last_success_timestamp; reconciliation_job last_success_timestamp; Completeness (by dataset): expected_partitions vs observed_partitions per day; late_event_rate (events arriving > 6h late) for unit_econ aggregation; row_count sanity (day-over-day delta banded); Reconciliation variance: daily variance_pct = (dashboard_total_cost - billing_total_cost) / billing_total_cost; variance plotted by region and tier, with table of top offenders for last 7d; Driver hints (lightweight): cache_savings_estimate coverage ratio and quantization_profile_tag_coverage (both are completeness indicators only; not paging). Alert rules (Prometheus): 1) UnitEconFreshnessLagHigh (warn): partition_lag_seconds_p95 > 2h for 2 consecutive evals; notifications to #eng-platform. 2) UnitEconFreshnessLagCritical (page): partition_lag_seconds_p95 > 6h for 30m; PagerDuty Eng SRE Oncall + #eng-sre. 3) UnitEconCompletenessDrop (warn): observed_partitions/expected_partitions < 0.995 for current day (excluding last 2h); #eng-platform. 4) UnitEconCompletenessCritical (page): observed_partitions/expected_partitions < 0.99 for 1h OR late_event_rate > 0.05 for 2h; PagerDuty + #eng-sre. 5) UnitEconReconciliationVarianceWarn: abs(variance_pct) > 0.0075 (0.75%) for D-1 totals for 2h; #finance-ops (Slack) + #eng-platform. 6) UnitEconReconciliationVarianceCritical (page): abs(variance_pct) > 0.02 (2%) for D-1 totals for 30m OR abs(variance_pct) > 0.05 (5%) at any point; PagerDuty + #eng-sre + #eng-platform. Notes on dimensions/cardinality: Alerts are aggregated at (region, customer_tier) only. We explicitly do not alert on model or runtime_config slices to avoid noisy cardinality and alert storms. The dashboard supports region + tier filtering; model-level drilldown remains in the application dashboard (redwood repo). Runbooks: Added runbook links for each alert to the internal oncall guide "Unit econ data quality" (same link used in annotations); includes steps for: checking ingestion lag, validating partition availability, running backfill tool, and temporarily excluding late partitions from reconciliation if needed. Testing/verification: Compiled Jsonnet dashboards/rules locally and via CI; Smoke-tested Alertmanager routing in staging by forcing partition_lag_seconds with a recording rule override; Verified Slack routing to #eng-sre and #eng-platform; Verified PagerDuty integration on staging service key. Screenshots: (a) Dashboard overview shows freshness lag charts (b) Reconciliation variance panel w/ region x tier table (c) Alert list with runbook links. Rollout plan: Merge -> deploy to staging observability stack -> enable Alertmanager routes for unit-econ alerts (staging) -> 24h soak -> promote to prod. References: Linear ENG-2917 (data quality monitoring) and ENG-2914 (reconciliation job). Commit summary: 1) dashboards: add unit_econ_data_quality dashboard + variables 2) alerts: add unit_econ_data_quality PrometheusRule group + recording rules 3) routing: add alertmanager routes + slack receivers 4) docs: add runbook link + standard annotations Changed areas/files (high level): dashboards/grafana/unit_econ_data_quality.jsonnet; alerts/prometheus/unit_econ_data_quality_rules.yaml; alertmanager/routes.yaml (unit-econ receiver + PD integration); dashboards/lib/panels.libsonnet (common freshness panel helper); docs/runbooks/unit_econ_data_quality.md; tests/jsonnet_compile_test.go; ci/lint_rules.sh. Review conversation highlights: Caleb Johnson: "Can we avoid model dimension in alert labels? Otherwise we will page on 1000x series." Author: "Yep—kept labels strictly region+tier and used dashboard variables for exploration." Aisha Bello: "Thresholds: 2h warn / 6h page seems right, but reconciliation needs an explicit D-1 guard; today is too noisy during backfills." Author: "Added D-1 gating and excluded last 2h of current day from completeness checks." Logan Wright: "Please add runbook steps for excluding late partitions from reconciliation (we used this during the variance spike)." Author: "Added a section + linked the mitigation query." Priya Natarajan: "Routing: warn to platform, page to SRE. Make sure Finance doesn’t get paged." Author: "Confirmed—Finance gets Slack mention on warn only; paging stays SRE + platform." CI checks: jsonnet-compile (pass), prometheus-rule-test (pass), grafana-dashboard-lint (pass), unit tests (pass). Merge outcome: Merged via squash into main.
